(rule!
 (let ((dummy 0))
  (define (bbox< a b)
   (cond ((not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))
         ((not (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))
         ((not (= (obj-r2 a) (obj-r2 b))) (< (obj-r2 a) (obj-r2 b)))
         (else (< (obj-c2 a) (obj-c2 b)))))
  (define (component-perimeter obj)
   (let ((cells (obj-cells obj)))
    (for/sum ((p (in-list cells)))
     (count-where
      (lambda (d)
       (not (member (list (+ (first p) (first d))
                          (+ (second p) (second d)))
                    cells)))
      cardinal-deltas))))
  (define palette (list 2 4 8))
  (define original (objects g 0))
  (define selector (obj-color (first original)))
  (define ranked
   (sort original
    (lambda (a b)
     (cond ((not (= (component-perimeter a) (component-perimeter b)))
            (< (component-perimeter a) (component-perimeter b)))
           ((not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))
           (else (bbox< a b))))))
  (define stage-a
   (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)))
             ((obj (in-list ranked)) (i (in-naturals 0)))
    (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) (list-ref palette i))))
  (define target-color
   (cond ((= selector 1) 2)
         ((= selector 3) 4)
         (else 8)))
  (define bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color stage-a target-color)))
  (for*/fold ((out stage-a))
             ((r (in-range (first bb) (+ (third bb) 1)))
              (c (in-range (second bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1))))
   (set-cell out r c target-color))))
